settings_registry_appearance_description: Theme, accent color, interface font, zoom and the layout of the file panel and panes.
settings_registry_appearance_pane_border: Outline the pane you are working in, in pixels. 0 hides it.
settings_registry_appearance_pane_opacit: How visible panes you are not using stay, from 0.2 (faint) to 1 (not dimmed).
settings_registry_appearance_panel_dock_: Show the file tree on the left or the right.
settings_registry_appearance_panel_file_: Show an icon next to each file.
settings_registry_appearance_panel_folde: Show an icon next to each folder.
settings_registry_appearance_panel_inden: How far each folder level is pushed in, in pixels.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_dark_: Colors used when Atlas is in dark mode.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_expor: Copy a theme as JSON or a Ghostty config, or save it to a file.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_impor: Bring a theme from Ghostty, iTerm, VS Code, Alacritty or Base16, or a zip or folder of themes.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_light: Colors used when Atlas is in light mode.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_mode_: Follow the system, or always use light or dark.
settings_registry_appearance_theme_termi: Use the app theme in terminals, or pick another one.
settings_registry_appearance_ui_font_des: Font for menus, sidebars and buttons.
settings_registry_appearance_ui_size_des: Text size across the app, in pixels.
settings_registry_appearance_ui_zoom_des: Scale the whole window. {zoomIn} and {zoomOut} step it, {reset} resets it.
